reason: I eat frozen momos and frankies late at night and despise the greasy, torn polythene chutney pouches sent with deliveries. Spending ₹179 to have neat squeeze tubes of hari and imli chutney ready in the fridge door is an easy impulse buy.
objection: The flip-top cap might build up crusted dried sauce around the orifice after a few days in the fridge.
would_change_my_mind: If the nozzle crusts over and clogs up, or if the taste feels overly sour and chemical-like, I won't reorder.
